name: Two Fires
short_role: Hold both bastions while demolition and specialist pressure strike together.
question: Can both posts remain staffed when demolition and specialist pressure split the command chain?
objective: Keep the paired-bastion protection active through at least two assault phases.
lesson: Twinwatch rewards two credible posts; one perfect anchor cannot protect an abandoned opposite side.

variations.preparation_focus: Staff both posts before specializing either one.
The western post bears the first structural threat.
The eastern post has more supplies but less morale margin.
